remarks: Welcome to this delightful second-floor apartment in a well-maintained two-family home, ideally situated at the end of a cul-de-sac. This charming unit offers hardwood floors throughout the spacious eat-in kitchen, living room, and two bedrooms. A bonus loft provides extra storage space and includes a private washer and dryer for added convenience. Enjoy an outdoor area in the fenced-in backyard patio, shared with the first-floor tenant. Located just minutes from the vibrant Historic South Norwalk (SoNo) and the expanding Wall Street area, you'll have easy access to an array of restaurants, shops, nightlife, The SoNo Collection Mall, the Maritime Aquarium, museums, movie theater, ice skating, SoNo Sports facility, trampoline park and more!  Commuters will love the proximity to the South Norwalk Metro-North Station (approx. 0.5 miles), with additional easy access to the Rowayton and Darien stations. Convenient to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, and just a short drive to Calf Pasture Beach and Cranbury Park-both free for Norwalk residents with valid car registration. Approximately 45 miles from Midtown Manhattan. Good credit required. Interior photos to come.
